mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1300K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% signals tightening, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) maintains a tight labor market, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when both industrial production (INDPRO) is above 105 and GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is positive, it signals a strong supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month, indicating reduced demand pressure, leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate slower growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL drops more than 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) being below 1.5% maintains an accommodative monetary environment, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month and unemployment (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200K in 1 month and UNRATE < 4%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during late-cycle expansions, an increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.8% in a month signals sustained consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
